svg.aria-label: SD card layout: GPT with partition fsbl1 and fsbl2 at 1 MiB holding BL2 for the Boot ROM, partition fip holding the FIP for BL2, partition u-boot-env at 9 MiB for U-Boot's raw environment, and an ext4 rootfs partition from 16 MiB that holds /boot/extlinux/extlinux.conf, the kernel zImage, the device tree and the root filesystem.
svg.text: What is on the SD card, and who reads each part
A GPT disk written by scripts/image.sh. The Boot ROM and BL2 find their partitions by NAME and TYPE, so the exact offsets are ours to choose.
• BL2: partition of the FIP TYPE GUID, or named fip
• U-Boot: the partition with the 'bootable' flag
• Linux: root=PARTUUID=… finds rootfs on any
mmcblk number: SD is not always mmcblk0
Sizes and GUIDs: config/stm32mp157f-dk2.conf. fsbl1/fsbl2/fip: names and GUID follow TF-A plat/st/common/bl2_io_storage.c and plat/st/common/include/stm32mp_efi.h.
U-Boot finds its environment by the partition name (u-boot,mmc-env-partition in arch/arm/dts/stm32mp157a-dk1-scmi-u-boot.dtsi, env/mmc.c); raw offsets 0x900000/0x940000 are only the fallback.
